font_names.description: Ordered list of font family names (fontconfig patterns) to try.

font_width.description: Force font width in pixels (0 = auto-detect).

font_height.description: Force font height in pixels (0 = auto-detect).

text_encodings.description: Additional text encodings (beyond locale default) to support via Ctrl+Alt+F2..F6.

ambiguous_wide.description: If true, treat ambiguous-width characters (e.g., in CJK) as wide.

input_method.description: Path to input method program (e.g., /usr/bin/fbterm-im); if empty, IM is disabled.

cursor_interval.description: Cursor flash interval in milliseconds (0 = no flashing).

vesa_mode.description: VESA video mode number (e.g., 0x317). If 0, fbterm uses framebuffer or auto-selects VESA mode.
